name: Spinophorosaurus
sum: Spinophorosaurus is a basal sauropod from the Middle Jurassic of Niger, known from two skeletons that together preserve most of the animal.
wsnote: The subadult holotype was about 13 m and the paratype about 14 m long; shoulder height about 4 m (Wikipedia revision).
holotype: A subadult skeleton excavated by German and Spanish teams in the 2000s.
material: Two skeletons that represent most of the skeleton of the genus, plus a juvenile.
biology: The name refers to what was first thought to be spiked osteoderms, later reinterpreted.
author: Remes et al. 2009
